image_qa.note: Both new editorial bodies and the mobile navigation enhancement are intentionally image-free. Their only image element is the unchanged Big Bud Man logo in shared site chrome; no agency, product, package, seller, medical, or affiliate image is represented or linked.

search_console.decision: The report covered August 24 through September 20: 518 impressions, one click, 0.2% CTR, and average position 61.6. The only position 4-20 page rows had one to four impressions, so no data-led rewrite was justified; those tiny samples and the single Oklahoma query click were deliberately ignored. Old submitted-sitemap errors were checked against the current live sitemap, feed, and site index rather than treated as a new topic signal.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy, scope-labeled source directory connecting CDC, NIH/NIDA, NIH/NCCIH, FDA, Poison Control, SAMHSA, CPSC, FTC, NHTSA, DOT, TSA, USDA, and state-regulator routes. Added a source-test and auditable source ledger, then connected the directory to complaint, recall, law, and product decision paths. Updated the qualified CANNRA opportunity to the new regulator-and-public-health routing asset; no outreach was sent.
